title: Agentbox run report
description: The single structured record a run hands back, produced by the harness image (or authored by the orchestrator on timeout/crash). Reported over the Dagster Pipes messages file: as report_asset_materialization metadata for asset agents, as a report_custom_message {"report": ...} for job-only agents.

tokens_in.description: Input tokens consumed; null when the run could not measure it (e.g. timeout).

tokens_out.description: Output tokens produced; null when unmeasured.

turns.description: Number of model turns; null when unmeasured.

cost_usd.description: Run cost in USD. Null for subscription harnesses (claude-code, codex) and when unknown; non-null for api and pi.

files_written.description: Count of files the run wrote to /output. The full path list is NOT here; it stays in the orchestrator's output-file snapshot metadata.

transcript_path.description: Host path of the run's .jsonl transcript. Filled by the orchestrator (the container cannot know the host path); the container leaves it null.

error.description: Human-readable failure/timeout explanation. Non-null if and only if status != ok.

notes.description: The run's final assistant message text (the agent's end-of-run note to its future self). Extracted from the harness's native events; no new prompt convention. Null if the run produced no assistant text.

examples.notes: Documented the factory module; next time start from definitions.py.
Reviewed the orchestrator; the from_op wiring is subtle.
